logic.signal: For a completed UTC daily close i-1, compute each asset simple return C[i-1]/C[i-1-L]-1. Select the asset with the higher return (BTC breaks exact ties); set target cash unless the winning return is strictly above the configured absolute hurdle.
logic.rebalance: Trade only on target change. If rotating, sell held coin completely before buying the new leader using remaining cash; if threshold is not met, sell to cash. While desired asset is unchanged, do not rebalance. A failed leg remains in current cash/coin state and the next daily decision retries only if target still differs.
logic.timing: Signals use completed daily closes only. Trade at next UTC day 00:01 one-minute open after signal availability; terminal close is costed at the common endpoint.
logic.sizing: Independent $2,000 spot account, 100% one-asset-or-cash target, no simultaneous holdings, leverage, short, interest, cross-account transfers, or pre-OOS fills.
